connectors.name: Sentry
connectors.description: Errors, releases, issues across your projects.

secrets.label: Access Token
secrets.help: User Auth Token from sentry.io/settings/account/api/auth-tokens. Recommended scopes: org:read, project:read, event:read, member:read, alerts:read. (The package reads this env as `SENTRY_ACCESS_TOKEN` — different from SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN used by other Sentry SDKs.) Note: this personal token validates against `sentry.io/api/0/` whoami and works for direct API calls, but Sentry's MCP server may still respond "Authorization Expired" because some tools require an OAuth-session credential rather than a personal access token. If MCP `whoami` keeps failing, expect to switch to an OAuth flow once Sentry exposes one.

secrets.label: Host
secrets.help: Defaults to sentry.io for the SaaS. Self-hosted Sentry: set to your domain (e.g. sentry.example.com).
